title: A1c Result Trend by Quarter
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:lab lab_source=* a1c_value=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(a1c_value) as metric by _time lab_source
| sort 0 _time lab_source
description: Trends monthly A1c result by lab source for quarterly A1c checks.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether quarterly A1c checks are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `lab_source` on `health:lab` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly A1c result.
visualization: Line chart of monthly A1c result by lab source.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how A1c result changes month by month for each lab source so you can see whether quarterly A1c checks are heading the right way.
